# Oasis Custom Decks

> Veteran-owned custom deck builder in Seven Fields, PA, serving Butler County and Pittsburgh's northern suburbs. TrexPro Platinum and TimberTech. Phone (724) 888-7288.

## Services
- [Composite Decks](https://oasiscustomdecks.com/our-services/composite-decks/): Composite decks built with Trex and TimberTech by a veteran-owned TrexPro Platinum contractor in Seven Fields, PA. Serving Cranberry and Pittsburgh North.
- [Roofs & Pergolas](https://oasiscustomdecks.com/our-services/roofs-pergolas/): Covered decks, gable roofs and custom pergolas from Oasis Custom Decks. Shade, rain cover and ceiling fans so your deck works in every season. Free estimate.
- [Trex RainEscape](https://oasiscustomdecks.com/our-services/trex-rain-escape/): Trex RainEscape under-deck drainage keeps the space below your elevated deck dry, so it becomes a usable patio. Installed by Oasis Custom Decks in Butler County
- [Outdoor Living](https://oasiscustomdecks.com/our-services/outdoor-living/): Outdoor living spaces designed around how you live: stairs, railings, lighting and layouts built by Oasis Custom Decks in Butler County and Pittsburgh North.
- [Deck Restoration & Resurfacing](https://oasiscustomdecks.com/our-services/deck-repair/): Worn boards on a solid frame? Oasis Custom Decks restores and resurfaces existing decks with new composite boards and railings. Free, honest estimate.
- [Porch builders](https://oasiscustomdecks.com/porch-builders/)
